extracted.intended_audience: public health professionals, researchers, New York State health agencies, grant applicants, technology licensees, and community partners
extracted.subtask_description: Organization homepage summarizing Health Research, Inc.'s mission, programs it manages, grant-supported initiatives, technology/innovation activities, and high-level program goals and priorities for New York State public health and research.

rubrics_metrics.name: HRI mission and organizational role
rubrics_metrics.description: Health Research Incorporated contributes to the health and well-being of the people of New York State by complementing and enabling the strategic public health goals of the New York State Department of Health (DOH), Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center (RPCC), and other health-related entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HRI provides best-in-class resource administration for stakeholders and programs related to DOH and partners through knowledge, expertise, funding guidance, and fiduciary oversight of sponsored program funding in concert with community partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center for Health Workforce Studies mission
rubrics_metrics.description: The Center is a research organization whose mission is to provide timely, accurate data and conduct policy-relevant research about the health workforce.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center collects, tracks, analyzes, interprets, and disseminates information about health professionals; its work is supported by grants and contracts managed by HRI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Health Emergency Preparedness grants purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants awarded to HRI support the efforts of the NYS Department of Health Office of Health Emergency Preparedness (OHEP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OHEP uses these funds to work with state and local agencies, local health departments and public/private partners to build an emergency preparedness response foundation to respond to public health emergencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prescription Drug Overdose Prevention - PDMP priority strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: CDC-awarded grant to HRI aims to strengthen and expand New York State’s Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) to address prescription drug misuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Four priority strategies are listed (page provides two explicitly): 1) Enhance and maximize the PDMP; 2) Implement health system interventions; (other strategies implied but not listed on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for Wadsworth Center / NCAN
rubrics_metrics.description: HRI provided support for the establishment of the National Center for Adaptive Neurotechnologies (NCAN) at the Wadsworth Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The NCAN is the culmination of decades of research supported by NIH institutes with additional support from HRI, indicating HRI's role in enabling translational research infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: AIDS Institute — Ending the Epidemic goal
rubrics_metrics.description: With CDC-managed grant funding overseen by HRI, New York State has a plan to end the AIDS epidemic with the goal of reducing new HIV infections to 750 per year (from an estimated 3,000) by the end of 2020.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit numeric program target tied to grant-supported interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Innovation Model (SIM) grant objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: New York State’s $100 million SIM testing grant, funded by CMS and managed by HRI, seeks to transform primary care delivery and payment models across the State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SIM aims to eventually reach 80 percent of New York’s primary care providers, payers, and patients and is part of statewide health system transformation efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology / Brain–Computer Interface description
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress in medical science now enables people with severe paralysis to live for many years and some have great difficulty communicating; brain–computer interface technologies aim to restore communication for those who are 'locked in.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page signals HRI's interest in technology translation and licensing (e.g., 'License Our Technology') and highlights translational priorities for assistive neurotechnologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for rehabilitation innovation (ACRM LaunchPad participation)
rubrics_metrics.description: HRI and NCAN entered LaunchPad, a Rehabilitation Technology Innovation Competition, and highlighted spinal reflex conditioning as an innovative rehabilitative technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This demonstrates HRI's role in supporting and showcasing rehabilitative technology innovations and technology-to-practice pathways.
